focus: TitanGlower: an unlisted CompGlower registered with GlowGrid for a moving pawn (Register/DeRegister safety, map removal, save/load, death/despawn, thingIDNumber collision with a pawn's own CompGlower), and the MapComponent tracking change
diffSource: since build 21 (2026-10-06T03:46:40Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: TitanGlower shares the pawn's thingIDNumber; on a pawn with its own CompGlower, DeRegister removes the wrong light
findings.detail: GlowGrid.GetGlowerIndex finds the light to remove by glower.parent.thingIDNumber and takes the first match, and TitanGlower's comp has parent = pawn. On a race that has its own CompGlower, each titan move removes the pawn's own light and leaves the titan's previous light at the old cell. The counts stay balanced, so nothing throws, but there is a stale light one move behind and the pawn's own light is gone. No vanilla race def has a CompGlower and no corpus mod calls RegisterGlower, so only modded glowing races are affected. One change: in Hediff_Titan.GlowTick, don't create a TitanGlower when pawn.GetComp<CompGlower>() != null (or log once and skip).

findings.title: Map change can deregister the light from the new map for a tick
findings.detail: When the creature changes maps, the old map's component still tracks it. If the new map's component has already ticked, the old one's p.Map != map branch calls CleanupEffecters(), and that calls glower.Remove(), which deregisters from the glower's stored map, now the new map. It also nulls trackedMap. The light is re-registered on the next GlowTick or hediff interval (Track is deduped), so it is a one-tick flicker and costs an extra flood. Cosmetic.

findings.title: The first burst of each effecter still uses the doubled offset
findings.detail: EffecterDef.SpawnAttached calls effecter.Trigger(target, target) before returning, using the TrueCenterCompensated offset. eff.offset = Vector3.zero is set afterwards, so only that first burst can appear off-centre on a pawn caught mid-step. Constructing with new Effecter(def) { offset = Vector3.zero, scale = ... } and calling Trigger yourself would avoid it.

findings.title: Glow on an undiscovered trait gives the trait away
findings.detail: ActiveGlow takes glow from every trait, discovered or not. The example Irradiated trait was made visible for this reason, but nothing warns a modder who puts glow on a hidden trait. A ConfigErrors warning would catch it. I did not get to read TitanTraitDef.ConfigErrors before the time limit.

checked: GlowGrid.RegisterGlower/DeRegisterGlower: litGlowers is a HashSet, so a double register or a deregister of an unregistered comp does nothing, and GetGlowerIndex cannot return -1 while counts stay bal…
Deregister after map removal: guarded by Find.Maps.Contains, and DeRegisterGlower also returns early when lights.IsCreated is false after Dispose (GlowGrid.cs:300, 497-505)

GlowLight(CompGlower) reads only Props.overlightRadius, GlowRadius, GlowColor, parent.def.plant, parent.thingIDNumber and parent.Position, so a comp that was never Initialize()d and is not in AllComp…
CompGlower's GlowColor/GlowRadius do not touch the parent's other comps, and the unlisted comp is never saved (PostExposeData only runs for AllComps)
Hediff removal: PostRemoved calls VisualsChanged, which calls glower.Remove (Hediff_Titan.cs:558-569, 254-257)
Death, despawn and leaving the map: MapComponentTick's !p.Spawned / p.Map != map / hediff-gone branch calls CleanupEffecters, which calls glower.Remove (TitanVisuals.cs:244-248, Hediff_Titan.cs:312)
Save/load: glower, activeGlow and glowResolved are [Unsaved] and rebuilt lazily by GlowTick, and the glow grid is rebuilt fresh on load
MapComponent_TitanVisuals.Track dedupes (TitanVisuals.cs:233-236), and GlowTick runs only for spawned pawns on that map
FollowCells logic: a moving pawn re-registers once 2+ cells away, and a stopped pawn catches up on the next tick
Effecter.offset is a public field, and the zero-offset rationale matches SpawnAttached's TrueCenterCompensated computation
Corpus: no third-party mod calls RegisterGlower, and no Races def in the corpus declares CompProperties_Glower
No Harmony patches in the diff, so the prefix and transpiler lint rules do not apply
